easy.q: How many Jonas Brothers are there?
easy.fact: Kevin, Joe and Nick reunited in 2019 after a six-year split.

easy.q: How many U.S. states start with the letter M?
easy.fact: Montana is the biggest of them.

easy.q: How many original colonies declared independence from Britain in 1776?
easy.fact: Georgia, founded in 1732, was the last of them.

easy.q: How many points is a touchdown worth in the NFL, before the extra point?
easy.fact: A two-point conversion can make it 8.

easy.q: How many dwarfs does Snow White meet in Disney's 1937 film?
easy.fact: Dopey is the only one without a beard.

medium.q: To the nearest year, how many years did Queen Elizabeth II reign?
medium.fact: She was the longest-reigning British monarch ever.

medium.q: How many seasons of The Big Bang Theory were made?
medium.fact: It ran from 2007 to 2019, ending with 279 episodes.

medium.q: How many time zones does Russia span?
medium.fact: When it's noon in Kaliningrad, it's 10 p.m. in Kamchatka.

medium.q: How many NBA championships did Kobe Bryant win?
medium.fact: He spent all 20 of his seasons with the Lakers.

medium.q: In what year did Grand Theft Auto V come out?
medium.fact: It has sold more than 200 million copies.

hard.q: How tall is the Washington Monument, to the nearest foot?
hard.fact: It took from 1848 to 1884 to finish.

hard.q: How deep is Oregon's Crater Lake, in feet?
hard.fact: It's the deepest lake in the United States.

hard.q: Cal Ripken Jr. holds the record for consecutive MLB games played. How many?
hard.fact: He passed Lou Gehrig's mark of 2,130 in 1995.

hard.q: Lil Nas X's Old Town Road spent how many weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100?
hard.fact: It held the top spot for 19 straight weeks in 2019.
